business_scope.primary_industry_name: Self-Insurance Risk Underwriting for Multinational Enterprise Groups

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Vanuatu (International Company under the International Companies Act [Cap 222])
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (English common law foundation, French civil law influence, and customary law; unitary national jurisdiction without provincial tax distinctions)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER Plus) - in force for Vanuatu since 2020
Melanesian Spearhead Group (MSG) Trade Agreement - in force
Pacific Island Countries Trade Agreement (PICTA) - in force for goods trade

No standalone BIT or comprehensive DTA currently in force with major capital-exporting states; investment protection rests on the International Companies Act [Cap 222], the Constitution, and VFSC licensing safeguards

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act [Cap 222] (notably ss. 8, 9 and beneficial-ownership record-keeping obligations); Captive Insurance Act [Cap 225] and Insurance Act [Cap 224] (licensing of captive reinsurers); Vanuatu Financial Services Commission Act [Cap 292]; Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2020 (Act No. 25 of 2020, as amended) and supporting regulations; Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit obligations; United Nations sanctions implementation via national regulations.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Certified Copy of Ultimate Parent Entity's Certificate of Incorporation or Equivalent Registry Extract
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry or notarial authority in the parent company's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Vanuatu is a party to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention; foreign public documents bearing an apostille are accepted without consular legalization)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Certified Copy of the Constitutional Documents (Memorandum & Articles / Equivalent) of Each UBO-owned Entity in the Ownership Chain
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public and/or corporate registry of the issuing jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified True Copies of Valid Government-Issued Passport Pages (Photo, Signature, and Personal Details) for all Identified UBOs above 25% and for Authorized Signatories
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing government passport authority; verification by licensed notary or VFSC-approved registered agent in Vanuatu
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille only if the passport copy is embodied in a notarial certificate; otherwise verified by the licensed Vanuatu registered agent under AML/CFT CDD rules

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified Banker's Reference and Source-of-Funds Letter for the Reinsurance Capital / Reserve Contribution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille on the notarial attestation of the bank officer's signature, where notarized

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolutions of the Ultimate Parent Approving Formation of the Vanuatu Captive Reinsurance SPV, Identity of UBOs, and Licensed Registered Agent Appointment
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Ultimate parent entity and its corporate secretary / notary

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory and documented CDD/EDD screening of all UBOs, directors, and administrators against the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit consolidated list, UN Security Council consolidated sanctions list, OFAC SDN list, and publicly available PEP databases; enhanced continuous monitoring and full audit trail retention; adverse media check; any PEP or sanctions match triggers suspension of incorporation and escalation to the VFSC and Vanuatu FIU per the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2020.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) - Registry of International Companies, online e-registration and name-reservation portal (https://vfsc.vu and associated VFSC electronic filing system)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Statutory filings are accepted in English; names must be expressed in Latin-script English or French characters. The proposed name must contain a required legal suffix under the International Companies Act [Cap 222], e.g., 'Limited', 'Ltd', 'Corporation', 'International Company', 'IC', or the French equivalent 'Société Anonyme' / 'SA'. Names must not be identical or deceptively similar to an existing registered entity in Vanuatu, must not misstate the entity's licensed status, and must not suggest governmental, banking, trust, or insurance character without prior approval.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Reinsurance (requires captive insurance licence under Captive Insurance Act [Cap 225] prior to use)
Insurance (requires Insurance Act [Cap 224] licence or captive licence prior to use)
Bank (requires international banking licence; otherwise prohibited)
Trust (requires trust-license holder status; otherwise prohibited)
Central / Reserve / National / Federal / Government / Crown / Royal / State (implies connection with public bodies; requires Ministerial consent, generally refused)
University / Chamber of Commerce / Exchange / Securities / Fund (sensitive tokens requiring regulatory or ministerial consent)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon name rejection, the applicant may file a written administrative appeal to the Registrar of International Companies at the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission, Port Vila, within 14 calendar days of rejection; the appeal must set out the proposed name, the statutory ground of refusal, legal argument, and a proposed phonetic or transliterated alternative. The VFSC Registry must issue a decision within 15 business days. If the appeal is denied, the applicant may seek judicial review before the Supreme Court of Vanuatu under the Judicial Review Act; expedited filing and legal representation in Vanuatu are recommended. A rejected name can also be refiled with amendment to remove the offending token.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A pure virtual office is not acceptable for this licensed captive reinsurance SPV. A Vanuatu International Company must maintain a registered office in Vanuatu through a VFSC-licensed registered agent. However, for a licensed captive reinsurer, VFSC expects genuine commercial substance: physical office premises, locally available records, appointed insurer or underwriter functions, and substantive governance meetings accessible to the Vanuatu Commissioner. Remote back-office support is permissible for administrative functions only, not for the statutory registered-agent and underwriting accountability functions.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Vanuatu International Companies Act [Cap. 222] (No. 32 of 1993, as amended), ss. 3-6 (incorporation and effect), s. 10 (registered office), s. 11 (resident agent), ss. 49-55 (directors), s. 66 (secretary); captive reinsurance licensing separately under the Insurance Act [Cap. 251] and applicable prudential regulations.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Port Vila, Vanuatu.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association of an International Company, lodged with a signed application for incorporation under s. 4 of the International Companies Act [Cap. 222].
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital or escrow deposit is imposed on an International Company; the memorandum may declare authorized capital of USD 50,000 to support captive solvency credibility, and shares may be allotted for promissory-note or deferred consideration. For captive reinsurance licensing, the VFSC requires a solvency margin and loss funds evidenced by an escrow-style trust account at a Vanuatu-licensed bank or a confirmed letter of credit.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST WRITTEN RESOLUTION OF THE SOLE SUBSCRIBER AND DIRECTORS OF [ENTITY NAME] LTD (an International Company under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222]). RESOLVED THAT: (1) the subscription is accepted and one ordinary share of USD 1.00 par value is allotted; (2) the registered office at Level 2, Imre Chambers, Kumul Highway, Port Vila is adopted and the VFSC-licensed resident agent is authorized to accept service of process; (3) [Director A] and [Director B] are appointed first directors, and [Officer C] is appointed Corporate Secretary and Money Laundering Reporting Officer; (4) the captive reinsurance licence application, solvency declaration, and payment of all incorporation and licence fees are authorized; (5) the corporate seal and share certificates are approved.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC International Companies Registry - e-Registry Portal / Licensed Registered Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a proposed company name ending in Limited, Ltd, Corp, Inc or a recognized equivalent, with three alternates. The Registrar screens for identical or misleading names and restricted words; terms such as Insurance, Reinsurance, Finance or Trust require an accompanying statutory licence application or a No-Objection clearances from the VFSC Insurance Division before reservation is confirmed.
required_dossiers: Name reservation application (Form NR-1)
Proposed name and three alternate names
Identity of the applicant or licensed registered agent (passport copy or corporate certificate)
Written authority from the proposed sole shareholder
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused, file an alternative name promptly; appeal the refusal in writing to the Registrar for ministerial review, or delete the restricted word while retaining the trade name through a licensed captive endorsement.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Lodgment of Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, VFSC, Port Vila
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute the memorandum and articles before a notary public or provide notarized and apostilled originals executed abroad; deliver the executed file, including statutory declaration of compliance and officer consents, to the VFSC counter or through the licensed resident agent under the authentication rules of the Act.
required_dossiers: Executed memorandum and articles of association
Statutory declaration of compliance by the applicant or registered agent
Notarized consent to act of each director and corporate secretary
Certified copy of the registered agent's VFSC licence and agency acceptance letter
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: The Registry may issue a query letter identifying formal defects; correct the file and re-lodge within seven days. If the application lapses, re-submit with a cover letter confirming payment continuity to avoid forfeiture of fees.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Remit the USD 300 incorporation fee by telegraphic transfer or bank draft payable to the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission, quoting the application file number; obtain an official stamped receipt; confirm that no capital duty, escrow deposit or paid-up capital evidence is required for registration of the International Company.
required_dossiers: SWIFT MT103 or bank transfer receipt
VFSC invoice or fee quotation
Application file number reference
Source-of-funds declaration if remittance exceeds standard filing threshold
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If remittance is queried or rejected, provide the MT103 trace and re-issue the payment from the approved bank; reconciliation errors are cured within 48 hours and do not suspend the incorporation timeline if the receipt is produced before certificate issuance.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon acceptance of the memorandum and payment, the Registrar signs and seals the Certificate of Incorporation bearing the registered number; the certificate is conclusive evidence of incorporation, and the company acquires the capacity and powers of a natural person from the date stated on the certificate.
required_dossiers: No further documents; issuance follows the approved file
Registered number and proposed official seal notation
Share certificate for the sole subscriber if requested at the same time
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate contains a clerical error, submit a written rectification request supported by the original certificate; if any registered file defect is identified, lodge a declaration of correction signed by the registered agent and pay the corrective filing fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registered Office, Resident Agent and Officer Filings
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC International Companies Registry and Licensed Resident Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the notice of registered office confirming a physical Vanuatu address and the appointment of a VFSC-licensed resident agent; file notices of directors and officers with signed consents; direct the resident agent to maintain the statutory registers of shareholders, directors and officers and to record the first board resolution in the corporate minute book.
required_dossiers: Notice of registered office (Form RO-1)
Notice of directors and officers with executed consents
Service-of-process undertaking of the resident agent
Minute book and share register opening sheets
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the resident agent licence is under review or suspended, appoint a successor VFSC-licensed agent and file the change within ten business days; if the physical office is found unoccupied, furnish proof of occupancy or relocate the registered office and file an amended notice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Captive Reinsurance Licence Application and Solvency Review
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for the captive reinsurance licence under the Insurance Act [Cap. 251]; submit a three-year reinsurance business plan, actuarial solvency certificate, parent-company captive purpose statement, reinsurance programme particulars and evidence of the loss fund; demonstrate that the captive writes only reinsurance of the parent group's risks and does not solicit public insurance business.
required_dossiers: Captive reinsurer business plan and three-year projections
Parent board resolution authorizing the Vanuatu captive
Actuarial solvency margin certification
Bank confirmation or letter of credit for the loss fund/escrow
AML/CFT programme appropriate to Medium-Risk Enhanced tier
Nomination of insurance manager, external auditor and loss fund trustee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Respond to VFSC queries in writing within the stated deadline; if solvency or capital adequacy is challenged, top up the loss fund or deliver an irrevocable parent guarantee; the licence may be granted conditionally, with its effective date aligned to the insurance contract inception.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal Business Licence and Physical Premises Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Port Vila City Council, Vanuatu Police Force Fire Service, Department of Labour, Vanuatu National Provident Fund and VEPA
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Secure a commercial lease with an occupancy permit; apply for the municipal business licence under the insurance services activity code; obtain fire safety certification covering egress, extinguishers and evacuation plan; register as an employer with the Vanuatu National Provident Fund; lodge a VEPA site desk file confirming a Category 3 exempt back-office; complete occupational health and workplace clearance.
required_dossiers: Commercial lease and building occupancy certificate
Municipal business licence application and fee receipt
Fire safety inspection report and compliance certificate
Company certificate of incorporation and licence reference
Vanuatu National Provident Fund employer registration
Labour Department occupational safety employer statement
VEPA environmental site registration desk file
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the fire inspection identifies structural obstructions, remedy means of escape and schedule re-inspection; if the council refuses the licence on zoning grounds, obtain the landlord's zoning clearance or relocate to a permitted office tower; appeal to the Minister for Internal Affairs within fourteen days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) - Insurance Supervision and Financial Services Licensing Division
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Captive Reinsurance Licence (Insurance Business Licence) issued by the Insurance Prudential Supervisor under the Insurance Act [Cap. 251]

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Vanuatu Environmental Protection Agency (VEPA), Ministry of Climate Change Adaptation, Meteorology, Geo-Hazards, Environment, Energy and Disaster Management
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 3 - Exempt (office-only captive SPV); no full Environmental Impact Assessment report required; a VEPA environmental registration desk file is mandatory; installation of a back-up diesel generator or any material renovation would trigger a Pollution Control Permit assessment.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Zero industrial process discharge; office wastewater discharged to the Port Vila municipal sewer under the Council trade waste by-law; standby generator exhaust limited to Vanuatu Ambient Air Quality guideline levels for NOx and PM10; UPS batteries and e-waste segregated and disposed through a licensed hazardous waste recycler with disposal manifests retained by the company.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate from the Vanuatu Police Force Fire Service covering extinguisher placement, clear egress routes and an evacuation plan; building occupancy and structural load certificate from Port Vila City Council Building Control; workplace registration and occupational safety clearance from the Department of Labour; employer registration with the Vanuatu National Provident Fund; premises must provide secure records storage, fireproof cabinets, controlled access and adequate first-aid and emergency preparedness for the licensed captive reinsurance operations.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry of Finance and Economic Management (MFEM) / Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – Corporate Registry; fiscal administration portal: https://www.mfem.gov.vu and https://www.vfsc.vu
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Vanuatu does not impose direct income tax on International Companies (ICs); therefore no national TIN or VAT ID is procured for income tax purposes. A foreign captive reinsurance SPV incorporated as a Vanuatu International Company must register with the VFSC Registry, obtain a Certificate of Incorporation, and pay the annual registration and business licence (where applicable) through the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) and the Ministry of Finance. Upon incorporation, an Internal Revenue compliance reference may be issued only if the entity engages in import/export activities subject to customs, but no statutory tax ID number is mandatory for the tax-exempt offshore captive operation.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box elections or hybrid mismatch elections exist under Vanuatu law. The International Companies Act provides an absolute statutory exemption from all Vanuatu taxes, duties, and levies (including stamp duty) for a minimum of 20 years, extendable by petition. No entity-level or pass-through election is offered because the captive reinsurance IC is automatically treated as a tax-exempt offshore entity within a zero-tax jurisdiction.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No national VAT/GST; indirect taxation is limited to customs duties under the Customs (Amendment) Act 2017 and stamp duty under the Stamp Duties Act [Cap. 68]. Reinsurance services are not imported goods and fall outside the indirect tax base.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable – no VAT/GST regime exists in Vanuatu. Customs duty registration is required only for physical importers/exporters; offshore reinsurance services and premiums have no local economic turnover threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No national e-invoicing or real-time fiscal clearance mandate exists for tax-exempt ICs. The Vanuatu Customs Service operates ASYCUDA World for customs declarations; however, this applies exclusively to cross-border movement of tangible goods and does not apply to the SPV's reinsurance contracts, premium flows, or claims payments. No digital stamping or API-based fiscal clearance is imposed on captive reinsurance documentation.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable – Vanuatu has no VAT/GST export zero-rating regime. As the captive reinsurance SPV derives all underwriting income from offshore sources and is statutorily exempt from tax, there is no scope to claim a zero rate on premium income or claims payments. The business structure is a tax-exempt export of financial services by operation of law, not by zero-rated VAT mechanics.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: No export zero-rating supported; mandatory documentation is limited to the VFSC annual filing and corporate records: Certificate of Incorporation, register of members, board minutes evidencing reinsurance contracts, and audited financial statements showing premium income retention.
For any tangible or incidental movement of goods, a Customs Export Declaration (ASYCUDA World) and commercial invoice are required, but these are not VAT refund substantiation instruments.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: No export VAT repayment exists, so no clawback penalty regime is legislated. However, if a captive IC is misused for fraudulent import/export practices or engages in trade activity not permitted under its international company licence, the VFSC may invoke anti-money laundering (AML) supervisory sanctions, including fines up to VUV 10,000,000 and revocation of the certificate of incorporation. The Customs Act imposes penalties for false export declarations of up to double the duty evaded plus forfeiture of goods. The absence of VAT refunds means no retrospective VAT clawback is applicable.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: The Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV), established under the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu Act [Cap. 322], is the central bank and exchange-control administrator. The Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) acts as the licensing and prudential supervisor of the captive reinsurance vehicle under the Insurance (Captive Insurance) regime and the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission Act No. 10 of 2017.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vatu (VUV) is a floating, freely convertible currency for current international transactions and is not subject to exchange-control licensing restrictions for insurance premiums, claims, profits, dividends, interest, or repatriation of capital when cleared through an RBV-licensed bank. Vanuatu has an open capital account in practice, but VUV is not a globally traded deliverable currency; USD and AUD accounts are operationally preferred. Principal remittance hurdles are documentary: banks will require the captive insurance licence, board resolutions, UBO disclosures, source-of-funds records, reinsurance treaty evidence, and confirmation that the International Company does not conduct domestic VUV business with residents.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory export-proceeds surrender or mandatory conversion ratio is currently imposed by the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu. Reinsurance premium income received from offshore cedents is treated as an invisible-trade earning and may be retained indefinitely in USD, AUD, EUR, or other approved foreign currency. There is no statutory timeline requiring conversion of such proceeds into VUV. Commercial banks may request an inward remittance purpose declaration identifying the reinsurance treaty and policy year for AML/CFT statistical purposes, but no RBV conversion mandate, surrender requirement, or custodial direction is triggered.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of South Pacific (Vanuatu) Limited (BSP Vanuatu)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational accounts for premium collection, claims disbursement, loss-reserve custody, and USD foreign-currency settlement; capital escrow account under the captive insurance licence, if required by the applicable captive insurance legislation.
Operational and reserve accounts in VUV, USD, and EUR; suitable for EU/EUR-corridor premium settlement and treasury clearing.

Operational account; available for statutory reserve deposits and government-relationship transactions; additional in-country substance documentation may be required for non-resident International Company account opening.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Offshore digital EMI solutions have medium feasibility as supplementary collection or payment rails, but low viability as the primary liquidity custodian. Legal constraints: an EMI not licensed by RBV cannot lawfully hold funds for, or provide deposit-taking services to, persons in Vanuatu under the Banking Act [Cap. 162]; use of a non-resident EMI as a bottleneck for premium or claims flows also weakens the bank’s source-of-funds audit trail and may be treated as an unregulated payment intermediary under the Financial Transactions Reporting Act [Cap. 251]. The optimal architecture is a fully regulated Vanuatu bank account with SWIFT and correspondent-bank clearing, supplemented by an EMI only where a cedent is in a restricted jurisdiction and the funds immediately flow onward to the licensed VU account.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: A physical in-country compliance interview is not an absolute statutory requirement for non-resident International Company accounts, but RBV-licensed banks generally require at least one of the following: (i) one director, the ultimate beneficial owner, and a designated signatory attend the Port Vila or Luganville branch for live verification; or (ii) a video-identification call conducted by the bank’s compliance officer with notarially certified identity pages and the original company file presented by the VFSC-registered agent. Remote and electronic opening is permitted in practice only where the bank’s AML committee approves an enhanced due diligence file, the board resolution expressly authorises electronic execution, and all corporate documents are apostilled or notarised, with English translations where applicable.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Captive is a tax-exempt International Company with layered non-resident ownership and no ordinary commercial substance.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of incorporation and current good-standing certificate issued by the VFSC or International Companies Registry; the captive insurance licence; board resolutions approving the banking relationship and treasury mandate; a beneficial-ownership schedule disclosing every natural person above the 10% or 25% threshold; corporate chart of the parent group; registered agent letter confirming registered office and record-keeping; and a business plan evidencing the captive’s reinsurance purpose.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inbound premium wires originate from related-party offshore reinsurers or group treasury centres, creating inter-group-movement red flags.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed reinsurance treaty or contract, policy slips, premium invoices, premium calculation schedules, risk-period documentation, cedent and retrocession data, board-approved actuarial or loss-reserve report, consolidated group financials evidencing the captive, transfer-pricing or arm’s-length benchmark commentary, and a source-of-funds declaration signed by the originating group treasurer.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident directors and absence of a physical office generate a suspected shell-company pattern.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: VFSC licence evidence; director passport copies and professional background summaries; current registered-agent and registered-office certificates; captive board minutes, risk policy, claims register, and underwriting documentation; external service-provider agreements with the registered agent, auditor, actuary, and claims administrator; and an annual compliance statement confirming that the captive does not trade with residents in Vanuatu.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Rapid outward disbursement of inward premium, presenting a potential pass-through or money-laundering layering pattern.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Funds-flow diagram reconciling each inbound premium to the corresponding outbound claim or retrocession payment; claim settlement files including loss advices, independent adjuster reports, and cedent bordereaux; loss-reserve funds maintained in a segregated or escrowed account; board-approved investment policy and FX hedging mandate; and an anti-money-laundering undertaking in the form required under the Financial Transactions Reporting Act.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Capital and premium injections must be routed by SWIFT MT103, or an equivalent real-time correspondent wire, to the captive’s RBV-licensed bank account in the currency specified by the treasury plan, normally USD or AUD. The instruction must carry the captive’s full legal name, the beneficiary bank’s SWIFT BIC, the account number, and a payment-details memo in the form: ‘Premium or capital contribution under [Reinsurance Treaty No. / Shareholder Resolution No.], risk period [dates], cedent [name]’. The originator’s bank should apply an ISO 20022 purpose code reflecting an insurance premium or intercompany funding; if the beneficiary bank uses domestic inward-remittance codes, the field should state ‘Reinsurance premium’ rather than ‘investment’ or ‘services’. Verification includes the underlying treaty or capital subscription resolution, board authorisation, VFSC licence, source-of-funds and beneficial-ownership records, and confirmation that no mandatory VUV conversion is required.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Claims and retrocession settlements should be cleared through the SWIFT network using an MT103 message for third-party beneficiary payments and an MT202 or MT205 message for interbank movement between the captive’s own accounts or group treasury accounts. USD disbursements are commonly routed through the relevant U.S. correspondent using CHIPS or Fedwire; EUR transactions through TARGET2; GBP transactions through CHAPS. The underlying claim file or retrocession instruction must be retained for the receiving bank’s AML/KYC review. Commercial letters of credit are not routine for reinsurance claims but may support collateralised-reinsurance obligations; a captive can arrange a standby letter of credit or bank guarantee to collateralise outstanding loss reserves in favour of a cedent, subject to VFSC prudential rules applicable to invested reserves and approved credit facilities.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Plain-vanilla deliverable foreign-exchange forwards in USD/VUV, AUD/VUV, and EUR/VUV executed with an RBV-licensed commercial bank, limited to expected premium, claims, and reserve exposures.
Non-deliverable foreign-exchange forwards in VUV, used offshore for the non-deliverable tail of VUV currency risk.
Cross-currency swaps in VUV/USD or USD/AUD matching the asset and liability cash-flow profile of the captive reinsurer.
Purchased foreign-exchange options, subject to board-approved treasury policy, where asymmetric hedging is justified by reserve requirements and the writer is a licensed bank.
Interest-rate and cross-currency swaps under ISDA and CSA documentation where the captive maintains collateralised credit support and does not speculate beyond its hedged non-VUV liabilities.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: International Company Annual Government Renewal Fee (Corporate Registry Maintenance)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Companies Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on the anniversary date of the certificate of incorporation; payment is due on or before the 30th day following the anniversary date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment converts the standard US$250 fee to the US$300 penalty fee (20% surcharge). Where the annual fee remains unpaid for 3 months past the due date, VFSC issues a striking-off notice; without remedy within the subsequent public notice period, the company is struck off the register, assets vest in the Government of Vanuatu, and each continuing defaulting director is liable to a summary fine.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Captive Reinsurance License Annual Renewal (Captive Insurance License Fee)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Insurance Division
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on the anniversary of the captive insurance license grant, prior to the commencement of the next license year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-renewal on the license anniversary automatically suspends the captive license; carrying on or continuing reinsurance underwriting during suspension constitutes unlicensed insurance business, exposing the SPV to a fine of up to VT 1,000,000 (approximately US$8,500) per offence and mandatory license revocation.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Audited Financial Statements and Solvency Certificate
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Insurance Division
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 3 months of the financial year-end of the captive reinsurance SPV, which is typically aligned with the parent group's fiscal year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file audited financial statements within the prescribed period triggers a VFSC notice of default, administrative penalties under the Insurance (Captive) Regulations, immediate cessation of new underwriting, non-renewal of the captive license, and revocation for persistent non-compliance.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Agent Annual Compliance Confirmation and Statutory Register Updating Record
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed Vanuatu Registered Agent (registered office holder under the International Companies Act, Cap 222)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before the incorporation anniversary; additionally within 30 days of any share transfer, director change, or amendment to constitutional documents
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Maintaining a registered agent and registered office in Vanuatu is a continuing statutory condition; the registered agent may resign on 30 days' notice, and VFSC may strike off the International Company after 60 days' notice of non-compliance, resulting in loss of separate legal personality and director disqualification.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Standard Vanuatu International Companies are exempt from statutory audit and financial statement filing; however, a captive reinsurance SPV holding a VFSC insurance/captive license is compulsorily subject to an independent annual audit regardless of premium volume, asset size, or shareholder composition (no de-minimis exemption). The audit must be performed by a licensed auditor approved by VFSC and the audited financial statements must be filed with the Insurance Division.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as adopted by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission; captive reinsurance SPVs are required to apply IFRS 17 (Insurance Contracts) for financial reporting, with solvency reporting prepared on a statutory basis prescribed by the Insurance (Captive) Regulations; books of account may be maintained in any major currency but must be convertible and retained in English.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Vanuatu International Companies maintain a confidential beneficial ownership register at the registered office; no public UBO return is filed with VFSC. The registered agent must obtain annual written confirmation from the directors identifying all beneficial owners and any share transfers executed during the year, and must update the UBO register within 30 days of any transfer of shares, issuance of new shares, or change in significant control. VFSC may require production of the register for AML/CFT supervision and fit-and-proper review of the captive licensee, and an up-to-date UBO confirmation is a condition precedent to captive license renewal.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Beneficial Owners (UBO register held at the registered office)
Register of Secretary and Registered Agent (as applicable)
Minute Book (for member and director resolutions)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: US$1,800 - US$3,500 per annum for registered office, registered agent, and corporate secretarial administration in Vanuatu
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: US$8,000 - US$20,000 per annum for the independent audit of a captive reinsurance SPV prepared under IFRS 17

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% - Vanuatu levies no corporate income tax on International Companies (ICs).
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Effectively 0% across all income categories. The International Companies Act 1992 grants ICs exemption from income tax, dividend tax, capital gains tax, withholding tax, stamp duty on share transfers, and exchange control. Captive reinsurance premium income, underwriting reserves, and claim payments attributable to foreign group risks are entirely outside the Vanuatu tax net. No incremental tax holiday is necessary because the baseline burden is already zero.
corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_limit_years: N/A (no corporate income tax regime exists; loss carryforward, set-off, and loss utilization concepts are inapplicable under Vanuatu domestic law)

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No corporate income tax return form exists in Vanuatu. The operative annual compliance instrument is the International Company Annual Return / Annual Renewal, submitted through the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) online registry portal by the licensed registered agent.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The renewal cycle is fixed by the registration anniversary: the annual return and government fee are due by 30 June for ICs registered in the first half of the year, and by 31 December for ICs registered in the second half. A prescribed late fee surcharge accrues from the day after the due date; no extension is available as of right.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Company name exactly as recorded on the certificate of incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The offshore name must match the VFSC register; no domestic tax identification number is required for non-resident owners.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: VFSC registration number allocated at incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Reference the register number only; do not insert any non-resident tax code or foreign taxpayer ID.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered office address in Vanuatu maintained at a licensed registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A physical Vanuatu address is mandatory; a post office box alone is insufficient.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full names, residential addresses, and nationalities of all directors.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Directors may be wholly non-resident; no local tax declaration, residency permit, or income tax filing status is created.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Company secretary and licensed registered agent particulars.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A licensed VFSC agent is compulsory; foreign corporate secretaries are not accepted for filing purposes.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Share capital structure, including number, class, and par value of issued shares.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No minimum paid-up capital and no authorized capital threshold applies; beneficial ownership is declared to the agent, not made public.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Beneficial ownership particulars maintained for AML/CFT compliance.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Each non-resident ultimate beneficial owner must be identified with passport, proof-of-address, and source-of-funds data held in the confidential register kept by the licensed agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Annual declaration of the captive reinsurance risk portfolio and confirmation that no domestic Vanuatu insurance risk is written.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Certify that direct risk is sourced exclusively from foreign group companies; writing Vanuatu domestic risk would trigger licensing and value added tax exposure.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Economic substance declaration filed pursuant to the post-2019 ESR amendments to the International Companies Act.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Identify board meeting minutes captured in Vanuatu, employees, physical premises, and annual expenditure attributable to direction and management in Vanuatu.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late lodgment and non-payment of the annual fee trigger a prescribed surcharge under the International Companies (Fees) Regulations. Persistent default beyond the statutory grace period exposes the IC to VFSC strike-off from the register, impairment of the registered agent's license, and reinstatement only upon satisfaction of all arrears, surcharges, and a new compliance declaration.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% - Vanuatu imposes no dividend withholding tax and has no deemed distribution regime; captive reinsurance profits may be remitted to the offshore parent group free of deduction.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Not applicable. Vanuatu has ratified no comprehensive double taxation agreement and operates only tax information exchange agreements (TIEAs) with certain jurisdictions. Consequently, there is no treaty relief application procedure and no TRC protocol for IC dividends. The domestic 0% rate is the terminal rate; the VFSC does not issue systematic tax residence certificates because no corporate income tax is payable.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory and effectively 0% for all cross-border royalty, interest, premium, claim, and reinsurance reserve payments; no gross-up obligation arises under Vanuatu law.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No Vanuatu transfer-pricing statute, Local File / Master File threshold, or arm's-length adjustment rule exists in VUV. Compliance pressure arises extraterritorially: the foreign parent group may trigger OECD Country-by-Country Reporting at the EUR 750 million (approximately VUV 97 billion) consolidated revenue threshold and must satisfy home-jurisdiction transfer pricing documentation rules covering the captive's reinsurance pricing and underwriting margins.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: CUP - Comparable Uncontrolled Price (quoted reinsurance tariff or market benchmark)
TNMM - Transactional Net Margin Method (profit margin on underwriting returns)
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Applicable for International Companies under the economic substance amendments introduced in 2019 as part of Vanuatu's OECD Forum on Harmful Tax Practices and FATF commitments. A captive reinsurer performing a relevant activity must demonstrate: (i) board direction and management exercised in Vanuatu, (ii) adequate physical premises, (iii) adequate full-time employees, and (iv) adequate annual operating expenditure. A standalone economic substance return must be filed annually with the VFSC; passive, dummy, or mailbox-only structures are prohibited.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Sham Risk Transfer / Tax Evasion Facilitation
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Issuing reinsurance contracts that transfer no genuine insurance risk from the foreign group companies, underwriting without actuarial justification, booking premiums solely to strip foreign taxable profits, or structuring retrocessions that recycle premium back to the parent without any risk exposure.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Prosecution under the International Companies Act and ancillary financial-services legislation: monetary penalties per offense, forfeiture of the IC's exempt status, compulsory strike-off, and referral to the OECD FHTP as a harmful preferential regime.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and beneficial owners face personal civil restitution for funds funneled through the sham arrangement, imprisonment for tax evasion facilitation, director disqualification for up to 10 years, and court-imposed travel bans preventing departure from Vanuatu pending investigation.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Absence of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operation with nominee directors, a mailbox registered office, no Vanuatu employees, no board minutes captured in-country, no local operating expenditure, or failure to file the annual economic substance declaration.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Immediate VFSC strike-off and cancellation of the captive structure, administrative fines for non-filing of the ESR return, revocation of the registered agent's authorization, and secondary inclusion on international blacklists that triggers global correspondent-bank de-risking.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal liability for company debts contracted after the strike-off date, confiscation of assets vesting in the Vanuatu Government, travel bans, and a statutory bar from acting as director or promoter of any Vanuatu international company.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Underwriting or accepting reinsurance risk for any person in Vanuatu or for the general market without the required VFSC insurance or financial services license, or operating a captive beyond the objects clause recorded in its constitutive documents.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Monetary penalties per violation, injunctions halting premium collection, revocation of the IC registration, and compulsory liquidation of the captive's Vanuatu trust assets.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Officers personally liable to policyholders for unpaid claims, restitution of all unearned premiums, imprisonment for conducting unlicensed financial business, and travel bans during the civil enforcement proceedings.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to perform customer due diligence on the cedant group, deliberate obscuring of beneficial ownership, routing premium-refund payments through shell intermediaries, or processing transactions involving sanctioned jurisdictions or politically exposed persons without enhanced oversight.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Vanuatu's Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act (Cap. 258, as amended): corporate fines up to VUV 50,000,000, confiscation of tainted funds, suspension or revocation of the VFSC license, and inclusion in the Financial Intelligence Unit's public enforcement register.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the licensed compliance officer face criminal fines, imprisonment for aggravated money laundering, personal asset forfeiture, international travel bans, and permanent disqualification from financial-services management in Vanuatu.
